purpose_context: This mission consolidates the approved redesign into canonical architecture, contracts, behavioral preservation boundaries, and a dependency-ordered delivery program. It defines GapDB authority and recovery, Beads tracker composition, Orchestrator API 2.0, truthful progress, stack-neutral acceptance, and the optional stateless MCP adapter without claiming those future implementation slices are already shipped.
purpose_tldr: Ratify the Go-native production architecture and decompose delivery into evidence-backed missions.
